creative_extensions.signal_direction: if LinkedIn employee count is materially below 53 OR role mix is dominated by IR/admin rather than chemistry/engineering = MODERATE operational-capacity concern

creative_extensions.source_label: Quebec Commission des normes, de l'equite, de la sante et de la securite du travail (CNESST) workplace-injury / employer registry
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://www.cnesst.gouv.qc.ca/en; CNESST publishes registered employer + workplace-establishment counts
creative_extensions.rationale: CNESST is the Quebec equivalent of OSHA. Every Quebec employer with workers must register and file annually. Lookup gives canonical Quebec-side workforce existence test.
creative_extensions.signal_direction: 0 registration = SEVERE contradiction; registration corroborates

creative_extensions.source_label: Glassdoor / Indeed Canada company-profile reviews
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://www.glassdoor.ca/Overview/Working-at-Loop-Industries; https://ca.indeed.com/cmp/Loop-Industries
creative_extensions.rationale: Insider-perspective sources may confirm or contradict declared headcount + worksite + role-mix. Useful sanity check on whether the Terrebonne operation has the engineering depth implied by a $40M-capex Spartanburg JV.
creative_extensions.expected_observable: review count + employee-role disclosures + perceived headcount
creative_extensions.signal_direction: very thin review base (e.g. <5 reviews ever) for a claimed 53-person engineering-heavy R&D operation = moderate concern

claims.extraction_notes: Catalog gap: DOL H-1B + OSHA + BLS QCEW are all US-only. LOOP's workforce is entirely in Quebec. PROPOSED is honest; the canonical adjudicator is Statistics Canada Business Register / CNESST. Worth testing because a real 53-person R&D + pilot-plant operation should leave a CNESST + LinkedIn footprint.
